study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Umbilical artery (UA) partial pressure of carbon dioxide (pCO2)
Patterns of UA acidosis (respiratory, mixed, metabolic)
cohort: The study included term, singleton, nonanomalous deliveries with universal cord gas collection.
finding: Umbilical artery hypercarbia is an independent predictor of neonatal morbidity, and UA mixed and metabolic acidosis carry significantly greater risk of neonatal morbidity compared with respiratory acidosis.
